agreement: Both versions have explicit retained agent-Harness artifacts changed by real feedback under an uneditable contract. D+H includes non-test data, D/H/M can co-evolve task weights and Harness, and separately learned improver parameters must be disclosed. Scientific/task-output artifacts alone do not establish Harness membership. Material experiment, unit, cohort and cost revisions are source-version-specific.
additional_guardrails: Scope review does not approve all new v2 numerical claims for an existing v1 public summary. Same-start/factorial claims must distinguish in-search from held-out outcomes.
Factorial interaction +0.50 pp has 95% CI [-0.520,1.520]; joint positive gain is not evidence of statistically established synergy.
The SWE appendix counts500 method records but250 paired seed-case observations (50cases×5seeds). The pair counts imply68.0% versus62.0%, not the historical v1 coding69.4% versus64.3%.
Planning outside an execution-only cap remains part of actual cost; at10% the44.05k total is not the6.32k drafting/verification charge.

A selected PyBaMM case is task-model calibration, and csvstat is taskcode with taskLoRA. Neither independently demonstrates agent-Harness revision; the cited online frozen-model csvcut supplement remains uninspected.
Cross-backbone transfer freezes an already trained improver; deployment is a single frozen search. Finite20-round cumulative results do not establish continual online or unbounded RSI.
Table means/selected arithmetic and HTML text checked; binary figure curves, raw seed logs, code and external supplements not validated.
